Remark
[Ricci tensor as a curvature contraction]

Source: petersen:page-0048 ↗ def:pet-ch1-contraction ↗ def:pet-ch1-curvature-types ↗ def:pet-ch1-ricci-types

The Ricci tensor is the contraction \[ \operatorname {Ric} =\operatorname {Ric}^i_jE_i\otimes \sigma ^j =R^{ij}_{ik}E_i\otimes \sigma ^j =R^i_{iks}g^{sk}E_i\otimes \sigma ^j. \] Equivalently, in covariant form, \[ \operatorname {Ric} =\operatorname {Ric}_{ij}\sigma ^i\otimes \sigma ^j =g^{kl}R_{kijl}\sigma ^i\otimes \sigma ^j. \] Type change identifies these formulas.
